observations.claim: Both near-tie candidates were rejected for np.count_nonzero. This round did not measure whether near-tie angular guidance helps.

memory_action.name: boolean-mask-cardinality
memory_action.description: Use Boolean-mask cardinality with supported NumPy
memory_action.body:
**Why:** Both round-3 proposals used disallowed np.count_nonzero.

**How to apply:** Use mask.sum() or direct masked indexing. Retain the same scoring idea when repairing its expression in the next Plan.

**Limitations:** Frozen six-instance CVRP development suite and current evaluator only.
